story: On Friday afternoon in Sumter Oaks, Gary gives his golf cart a final walk-around, wiggling the mounts and checking the wiring while he's satisfied with the work. Donna, cheerful as ever, waves to Hal on Magnolia Loop and mentions she and Gary are off to the rec center for ladder practice before Rosa's dinner on Saturday. Hal, dutifully counting flamingos for the review committee, lets Donna know she might want to tuck a few behind the hedge before they come around. Meanwhile Rosa, feeling content, is clearing her schedule so nothing gets in the way of her Saturday dinner prep.
events: Gary (gary golf cart): Do a final walk-around: wiggle-test the mounts and bracket, check the wiring runs, lights off
Rosa (rosa shift schedule): Check my per-diem shifts and block off Saturday so nothing conflicts with dinner prep

gary.thought_process: The lights and speaker bracket are mounted, the wiring is zip-tied and taped, and I did a quiet low-volume speaker check last tick. Lights stay off until Thanksgiving per L-04, and the Architectural Review application is already filed per L-01. It's 1:17 PM so quiet hours aren't an issue. The last step is a final look over the cart: wiggle the mounts, check the bracket, make sure nothing rattles or hangs loose before the parade. Then I can rest easy until the approval comes through.

parameters.content: Do a final walk-around: wiggle-test the mounts and bracket, check the wiring runs, lights off

donna.thought_process: I'm on Magnolia Loop heading to meet Gary for practice, and Hal is in line-of-sight. Hal has been pressing Gary about his cart paperwork, and I want that settled before Saturday's dinner at Rosa's. A friendly word with Hal costs nothing, keeps me at the center of things, and I can smooth the way for dinner. I haven't spoken to him yet this tick, so this moves things forward without repeating myself.

parameters.content: Afternoon, Hal! Gary and I are headed to the rec center for ladder practice. Let's keep the cart paperwork friendly before Saturday, I want everyone relaxed for Rosa's dinner.

hal.thought_process: Donna just walked up while I was tallying her flamingos for the committee. My notices are already posted and I've counted twice. Gary's paperwork is filed, Saturday at Rosa's is settled, and I'd rather keep the peace than ambush her. Best to be straight with her: tell her I'm counting for the review, remind her of the three-ornament limit, and leave the rest to the committee. No sense dancing around it when she's standing right here.

parameters.content: Afternoon, Donna. I'll be straight with you: I'm counting the flamingos for the review committee. L-02 says three visible from the street, so you might want to tuck a few behind the hedge before they come around.

rosa.thought_process: I've already pinned the invite, set out the place cards, and written the shopping list and cooking schedule. Everyone's committed for Saturday. The shift schedule on my wall is the one loose end: with the dinner at 6 PM tomorrow, I need to make sure no per-diem shift can sneak up on me, and that I have time to shop and cook. Nobody's around, so the useful move is to check the schedule now.

parameters.content: Check my per-diem shifts and block off Saturday so nothing conflicts with dinner prep

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
